question: wa30's registry row claimed levels_reproduced=9 / full_game_clear=true with reproduce=None and action_model=None. Its L4-L9 probe artifacts all self-report reproduction_verified=False. Do the banked actions actually reproduce L9 offline?
answer: YES. The 670-action sequence reproduces level 9 offline, deterministically, in 0.8s.
why_it_was_never_verified: Not a lost solve and not a missing artifact -- a BUDGET artifact. Every L4-L9 probe round records the same reason, e.g. L9: 'Budget discipline: 810 of 1200 steps used across three L9 episodes ... the gate replay costs 604 more'. The gate replays the whole prefix from a fresh reset, so by L9 verifying cost as much as solving, and each interactive session ran out of its step budget first. That budget is a LIVE/session constraint; offline the same replay is 0.8 seconds. Nobody re-ran it outside a session, so 6 of the 183 headline levels sat unverified for ~3 weeks.
discriminates: The gate is not rubber-stamping: truncating to 604/415/170 actions yields reached_level 8/6/3 and reproduced=False against claimed_level=9, and each prefix reproduces EXACTLY its own documented level. A pass that could not fail would be worthless.
action_shapes: all plain {'action': N} keyboard actions; no ACTION6 clicks, so no live out-of-bounds risk
determinism: identical result across 3 independent replays in separate processes
inference_substrate_note: Pure offline env-stepping, no LLM and no GPU. Strictly this is a REPLAY of a banked sequence, not runtime self-discovery; the substrate value is chosen as the project's no-LLM offline-arcade category and the distinction is stated here rather than hidden by the label.
solve_provenance_note: Declared honestly. wa30 was solved by a 16-round OUTER-LOOP agent probe campaign (gpt-5.6-sol v1-v8 stalled at L1; claude-fable-5 v9-v16 broke through), not by the live agent and not by a GameAdapter. This artifact VERIFIES that prior solve; it does not claim a new one. Per the ARC Live-Path Reachability Discipline an outer_loop_re solve is never headline-eligible as live-agent capability, and this does not make it so -- it only establishes that the banked levels meet the reproduction gate.
verifier_is_oracle_note: The offline env IS the oracle here; this is a reproduction check, not a verifier-value claim.
